description: Source code implementing DDR initialization, configuration, and timing routines for an embedded system, specifically for the ox820 platform. Contains structures, constants, and functions for DDR setup, polling, and command issuance.

methods.name: ddr_phy_poll_until_locked
methods.description: Polls DDR PHY register until the PHY is locked (bits 30 and 31 set).

methods.name: ddr_poll_until_not_busy
methods.description: Polls DDR status register until the DDR core is not busy (bit 31 clear).

methods.name: ddr_issue_command
methods.description: Issues a command to DDR and waits until the command completes.

methods.name: ddr_timing_initialisation
methods.description: Initializes DDR controller registers with specified timing parameters.

methods.name: ddr_normal_initialisation
methods.description: Performs DDR normal initialization sequence based on configuration parameters and clock speed.

methods.name: ddr_setup
methods.description: Main function to set up DDR with specified MHz, including clock enabling and reset sequences.

methods.name: set_ddr_timing
methods.description: Adjusts DDR read/write timing delays dynamically.

methods.name: init_ddr
methods.description: Initializes DDR subsystem, starting clocks and performing setup at given MHz.
